verdict.rationale: Datalab documents webhooks that notify when processing jobs complete, and pipelines that chain processors into reusable configurations. Neither is a user-defined rule system that automatically triggers actions on events. Webhooks are an outbound notification building block that a developer would need to wire into their own automation, and pipelines are invoked configurations rather than event-driven rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
